reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "2 capsules in each sachet", and I hate swallowing pills. The pretty box and the QR are nice, but I would rather have a drink mix or gummies.
objection: Two capsules every day, and nobody tells me how big they are. If they are horse pills, I will not take them, and then I have wasted $30.
would_change_my_mind: A clear size of the capsule (small, easy to swallow), or a powder or drink-mix version at a similar price.
